name: Shetron Limited
summary: Shetron Limited, established on June 9, 1980, operates from its headquarters in Mumbai, India, focusing on the production of diverse metal packaging solutions. The company's wide array of products includes various containers tailored for food, beverages, and decorative uses. Additionally, Shetron manufactures specialized components such as round parts, penny levers, TRF, and RLT assemblies. Their portfolio also extends to twist-off caps, conipails, and round metal battery jackets, alongside the supply of printed and coated tinplate metal sheets.
